response.sql: WITH status_totals AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count, 1.0 * SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), rate_average AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_rate FROM status_totals) SELECT st.status, st.total_scan_count, st.gb_per_minute, st.gb_per_minute - ra.average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM status_totals AS st CROSS JOIN rate_average AS ra WHERE st.gb_per_minute > ra.average_rate
